description: Restarts video clip rendering for a failed video drop, replacing its clips. Use when a video post shows status failed and the user wants to try again. Not for rewriting copy or covers (use regenerate_drop_copy or regenerate_drop_cover). Returns the drop with status processing; check it later with get_drop. Works on failed video posts only.

drop_id.description: ID of the drop. Get it from list_team_drops or create_drop.

locale.description: Language for names and text, as a short code, e.g. "en", "es", "de". Omit for the team default.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: regenerate_drop_clips
title: Regenerate drop clips
